decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 6 months from the date of this approval.  Failure to complete the works in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith, hereby approved, will result in enforcement action being implemented.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and hereby approved.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials including not only the brick to be used but also mortar specification and joint profile to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Removal of the existing front boundary fence and erection of a new boundary wall and railing to the house incorporating alterations to side boundary fences.
